name: WatchYourLAN
description:
WatchYourLAN


Lightweight network IP scanner with web GUI. Features: - Send notification when new host is found - Monitor hosts online/offline history - Keep a list of all hosts in the network - Send data to `InfluxDB2` to make a `Grafana` dashboard > WatchYourLAN supports `vlan`s, `docker0` and other complicated scans since `v2.0.1`. How-to [here](https://github.com/aceberg/WatchYourLAN/blob/main/docs/VLAN_ARP_SCAN.md). ![Screenshot_1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aceberg/WatchYourLAN/main/assets/Screenshot_1.png) ## More screenshots

questions.label: Network interfaces
questions.hint: Space separated list of network interfaces to scan

compose:
services:
  watchyourlan:
    image: aceberg/watchyourlan:2.1.4
    container_name: watchyourlan
    restart: unless-stopped
    network-mode: host
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data/WatchYourLAN
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - IFACES=${WATCHYOURLAN_IFACES}
